title: Glute Sculpt High-Rise Leggings
description: Sculptiva’s signature glute legging, built around a high-rise compression waistband and a contouring scrunch seam that highlights your natural shape. Contouring scrunch seam High-rise compression waistband Buttery stretch fabric Made for heavy lifts, training days, and slow Sundays Pair them with a Sculptiva sports bra or longline bra for a full set that feels as good off the gym floor as it does on it.

title: Seamless Sculpt Knit Leggings
description: Zero seams, easy styling. These sculpt leggings use a second-skin knit and targeted shading under the glutes for a smooth, lifted look. Seamless knit construction Second-skin feel Targeted shading under the glutes Choose them when you want a clean, minimal base for training sets, studio looks, and everyday movement.

title: Sculpt 5-Inch Training Shorts
description: A focused training short with a 5-inch inseam and the details that make movement feel easier. 5-inch inseam Glute-lifting scrunch detail No front seam Designed to stay put through squats, sprints, and stretches Reach for them on training days when you want a clean, streamlined shape without extra fuss.

title: Ribbed Sculpt Scrunch Shorts
description: Soft ribbed texture meets Sculptiva’s signature contour scrunch in a short made for lounge-to-lift days. Soft ribbed texture Contour scrunch detail Versatile styling for rest days and training Pair them with the Sculpt Longline Crop Bra or your favourite oversized layer for an easy set that feels considered without trying too hard.

title: Sculpt Medium-Support Sports Bra
description: Your everyday training bra, with medium support and a smooth sculpted feel that keeps your kit simple. Medium-support design Removable pads Soft, buttery underband Wear it for workouts, layering, or pairing with your favourite Sculptiva leggings and shorts when you want an easy matching set.

title: Sculpt Longline Crop Bra
description: An extended-length bra with a sculpted neckline, designed to work as a standalone crop or as part of your training set. Longline silhouette Sculpted neckline Studio-to-street support Wear it with Sculptiva leggings or shorts for a clean matching look, or let the longer shape stand on its own.

title: SculptFlex™ High-Waisted Contour Leggings
description: Contour-led leggings designed for a supported, confident feel through training and everyday movement. Contour-enhancing panels for a sculpted look High-waisted support Ultra-soft stretch fabric Pair them with your favourite Sculptiva bra for a streamlined set that moves from the gym into the rest of your day.

title: Fabric Resistance Band Bundle
description: A simple way to add resistance to glute sessions, home workouts, and training on the go. Three fabric resistance bands: light, medium, and heavy Carry pouch for easy storage and workouts anywhere Keep the full set in your gym bag and choose the level that suits your session, from lighter activation work to a more challenging burn.
